fields.summary: If new claimants see the first-claim checklist, the share who submit a claim rises from 0.10 to 0.12.
fields.baseline: 0.10 conversion to claim_submitted over the 28 days before 2026-10-12, from PostHog
fields.min_sample: 3841 per arm; two-sided two-proportion z-test, alpha 0.05, power 0.8, baseline rate 0.10, detectable rate 0.12
